blockingIssues.description: Original issue #1: handleCreateSingleVista() still calls createVista() which makes direct API call via apiCall() without checking isOnline(). The fix provides useCreateVista hook but it's not used in the component.

Original issue #2: handleCreateGroupVisitas() still calls bulkCreateVisitas() which makes direct bulk API call without checking isOnline(). The fix provides useCreateVisitasFromGroup hook but it's not used in the component.

Original issue #3: handleMarkAsPurchased() and handleMarkAsNotPurchased() still call updateVistaStatus() which makes direct API calls without offline-first logic. The fix provides useUpdateVista hook but it's not used in the component.
Original issue #4: handleGenerateSale() uses useCreateDraftSale() mutation which is not offline-aware. The use-sales.ts hook doesn't use useOfflineAwareMutation.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add explicit scope guidance: When fixing offline-first issues, ensure the fix covers BOTH the hook layer (useOfflineAwareMutation) AND the component layer (using the new hooks in the component). A fix that only adds hooks without integrating them into components is incomplete.
